business_problem: Nationwide Building Society needed a better way to support member data unification, personalization, and fraud-aware service intelligence because nineteen legacy warehouses made it difficult to establish a trusted customer view for real-time personalization and fraud prevention.
solution_summary: Nationwide Building Society uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support member data unification, personalization, and fraud-aware service intelligence. The implementation replaced a legacy state where nineteen legacy warehouses made it difficult to establish a trusted customer view for real-time personalization and fraud prevention. Member data and behavioral events move through Structured Streaming and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow, Genie, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver personalized member experiences and fraud prevention insights.
business_outcome: Nationwide Building Society improved member data unification, personalization, and fraud-aware service intelligence with measurable results including 19 to 2 and 12 months consolidated data warehouses for faster insights, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
metrics: 12 months consolidated data warehouses for faster insights
architecture_clues: Centralized governance, lineage, and access controls are enforced through Unity Catalog.
Delta Lake provides the shared storage layer for curated lakehouse datasets.
Automated ingestion and transformation pipelines keep source data synchronized for downstream analytics and AI.
Operational AI workflows are deployed directly beside governed data and analytics assets.
evidence_quotes: We’re not a bank. We’re a building society that operates on mutuality. When we do well, our customers and members benefit,
We’re using behavioral data to predict what they might need next,
Analyzing abnormal patterns is increasingly driven by data. Plus, we’re powering operational reporting across the organization,
Whether it’s regulatory reporting, financial analytics or customer service and marketing initiatives, our teams rely on timely, trusted data.
